summary: Iteration 8 (11th round) verification of grow/shrink animation fixes on the 13x13 emotion grid. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass (GET /api/emotions returns exactly 169). Frontend: in-page rAF sampling (3 repeat runs) of .bubble-scale computed width and edge-to-edge gap between emotion-bubble-0-0 and emotion-bubble-1-0. RESULTS: (1) GROW pre-paint snap FIXED — first sample after click is always scale=1.000 (t=112-165ms), progressively 1.41 -> 1.50, never >=1.4 on frame 0. (2) GROW min edge gap = 9.75px in all 3 runs (exactly the rest gap, never dips) PASS. (3) SHRINK pop FIXED — first sample 1.500, max sample 1.500 (<=1.55), decays to 1.000; no 1.87 pop. (4) SHRINK min gap 10.18px (>=9) PASS. (5) SHRINK convergence: neighbor within 0.65px of baseline at ~2000ms PASS. (6) NO HOVER: .bubble.is-hovered never present after 400ms hover on 3 bubbles PASS. (7) DETAIL PANEL: emotion-bubble-3-3 -> detail-name='Cheerful'; detail-coord/detail-source testids and .detail-coord/.detail-source nodes count 0 PASS. ONLY MARGINAL ITEM: GROW sync metric at ~420ms measured 84.9% / 65.1% / 101.5% across runs (target >=85%).

integration_issues.flow: GROW sync metric (neighbor displacement at t=420ms)
integration_issues.issue: Neighbor displacement reaches only 65-101% of final travel at the sample nearest 420ms (mean ~84%, threshold 85%). Measured against the visual scale progress at the SAME instant, displacement consistently trails the scale by ~15-17 percentage points (e.g. scale 82.2% vs disp 65.1%; scale 99.6% vs disp 84.9%). Container renders at ~6fps so the sample nearest 420ms lands anywhere from 322-559ms, making the strict 420ms threshold unmeasurable with confidence. Physically harmless: the min edge gap never dropped below the 9.75px rest gap in any run, so no crowding/overlap is visible. Treat as a soft/observational item, not a regression.

action_items: Optional: to close the last ~15pp physics lag, run sim.tick() with more iterations (or apply the eased radius one frame ahead) during the grow ramp so neighbor displacement matches scale progress. Not user-visible — gap invariant already holds.

Cleanup: SHRINK_MS constant is used for BOTH grow and shrink durations (rename to RAMP_MS); stale comments at EmotionGrid.js lines 39-43 and 50-54 still reference a 'CSS scale transition' that no longer exists.
critical_code_review_comments: EmotionGrid.js: animateNodeRadius calls collide.radius(collide.radius()) every frame to reinitialise cached radii for all 169 nodes — O(n) per frame plus sim.tick(5); acceptable at this size but the main CPU cost of the ramp.
EmotionGrid.js is 486 lines and mixes data fetch, physics and render — fine for now, but splitting the simulation into a useEmotionSimulation hook would ease future changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified at 97% zoom: base .bubble-scale width 52.64px, rest center dist 62.38px, rest edge gap 9.75px. Sampling method that works: page.evaluate that pushes samples in a rAF loop started in the same JS turn as el.click() — container is ~6fps so expect only 15-18 samples in 2.5s; do NOT assert on exact timestamps, assert on invariants (first-sample scale, min gap, max scale, final convergence). Grow: first sample scale must be 1.0; shrink: first/max 1.5. All 9 requested checks except the 420ms sync ratio are green.
rca_of_the_issue: Remaining sync shortfall: the d3 collision push is computed from node.radius which is updated at the start of each rAF frame; at ~6fps the neighbor position resolved in that frame reflects the radius from the previous frame, so displacement trails the inline scale by roughly one frame (~15pp). Since the collision radius includes SELECTED_PADDING (10px), the trailing displacement still keeps the visible edge gap at or above the 9.75px rest gap, so the previously reported -3.41px overlap is fully resolved.
